pools.description: Single Source of Truth states in Riverpod. All N must be accounted for here.

nitrate_NO3.soil_interaction: Prone to leaching with water flux

processes.description: Transformations between pools. Must follow strict environmental conditions.

denitrification.visual_trigger: Gas emission particles escaping to atmosphere

immobilization.visual_trigger: Particles physically anchored to microbial clusters

plant_uptake.visual_trigger: Particles enter root and travel up xylem

simulation_rules.mass_balance: Total System N = organic_nitrogen + ammonium_NH4 + nitrate_NO3 + microbial_biomass_N + plant_biomass_N + leached_N + denitrified_N
simulation_rules.atomic_updates: All pool updates MUST execute inside a single transaction/solver tick to prevent state desync.
simulation_rules.leaching_logic: NO3- travels downwards with gravity/water. NH4+ stays anchored near generation point due to CEC.
